note: Adventurers now store their dungeon hauls: when one returns from a delve, their gold goes to the Mosslight bank and their loot goes into their family chest — every house has one, and the log tells you exactly what went where. Nothing vanishes: every coin and item from a run is accounted for in a chest or the bank, and old saves gain empty chests automatically. Stored loot stays put for now — it is not spent, traded, or withdrawn yet — and your own dungeons, loot, and inventory work exactly as before.
